name: av_ev_two_in_one_step
source:
{ Two guards that cross 2 ms apart, well inside one adaptive step of a smooth
  linear ramp. Both crossings are recorded, in time order: a `record` action
  does not end the step, so it cannot swallow a later crossing (FX7/E01). }
DYNAMIC ramp (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 10, points = 6)
  der(Yv) = 1
  Yv(0) = 0
  EVENT a: Yv = 5 | rising -> record
  EVENT b: Yv = 5.002 | rising -> record
END

oracle.engine: frees-core (Rust), graded against a closed form
oracle.generated_by: Regenerated 2026-11-24 from the Rust engine after FX7 (owner-approved). Exact answer: a at t = 5, b at t = 5.002 on the ramp Yv = t. The Java oracle accepted the whole step after the first record and swallowed b.
